neighbours.label: ' a' or ' an' after 'X is' when defining an electronic part ('A capacitor is an')
fire: A transistor is a small device that amplifies a signal.
An inductor is an electrical part that stores energy.
A relay is an electrical switch driven by a coil.
A fuse is a safety device that breaks a circuit.
A thermistor is a resistor that changes with heat.
A rectifier is a circuit that converts AC to DC.
An oscillator is a circuit that produces a steady signal.
A potentiometer is a variable resistor with three pins.
quiet: A hammer is a small tool that drives a nail.
An anvil is an iron block that takes a blow.
A rake is a garden tool with long teeth.
A gate is a safety barrier that closes a road.
A kettle is a pot that boils water with heat.
A tractor is a vehicle that pulls a plough.
An orchard is a field that produces a steady crop.
A wheelbarrow is a small cart with one wheel.

notes: Second round. In the first round the peak was on ' a' or ' an' in definitions and other electronics sentences stayed low.
